hooks.block:
<!-- BEGIN adaptive-review:gsd-shadow:plan -->
**Adaptive review shadow callback — completed plan:** After the plan completion spot-check succeeds, derive the exact plan path set from that plan's PLAN/SUMMARY and commits. Never use the whole dirty tree. Run `__WSL_WORKSPACE__/hermes-agent-self-evolution/scripts/adaptive-code-review.py evaluate --scope plan --required-level S1` with one `--path` per exact path and store its JSON under `.planning/review-evidence/shadow-events/plan/`. If exact scope is unavailable, record `INCONCLUSIVE`. This callback is non-authoritative, cannot gate completion, cannot remediate, and cannot start S4; an S4 recommendation is notification-only.
<!-- END adaptive-review:gsd-shadow:plan -->

hooks.block:
<!-- BEGIN adaptive-review:gsd-shadow:wave_close -->
**Adaptive review shadow callback — wave close:** Aggregate identity-matching completed-plan receipts first. Evaluate only uncovered exact paths at checkpoint scope (S0-S1). Never reread covered content or absorb unrelated dirty paths. Store the non-authoritative result under `.planning/review-evidence/shadow-events/checkpoint/`; `INCONCLUSIVE` is visible but does not gate the wave. No automatic fix or S4 is permitted.
<!-- END adaptive-review:gsd-shadow:wave_close -->

<!-- BEGIN adaptive-review:gsd-shadow:phase -->
**Adaptive review shadow callback — completed phase:** Before the fixed review, aggregate compatible plan receipts and evaluate only uncovered cross-plan seams at phase scope (S0-S3). Write a non-authoritative shadow result under `.planning/review-evidence/shadow-events/phase/`. The existing `gsd-code-review` invocation below remains the sole authoritative owner and adaptive metrics must not duplicate its metrics. Shadow results never gate closure, invoke remediation, or start S4.
<!-- END adaptive-review:gsd-shadow:phase -->
